copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 管理消息频道与代理组的连接。Claude能检查当前连接状态、创建新连接、修改或删除连接，并指导你使用命令行工具完成配置。
howto.when: 在你添加新频道后、初始设置时，或需要重新配置现有频道与代理组的关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我把我的Discord频道连接到支持代理组。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成连接步骤。

say.text: 检查哪些频道已配置但未连接到代理组。
我想在Telegram上添加一个新群组并连接到现有代理。
say.note: Claude会询问隔离级别并执行注册。

howto.what_en: Manage how messaging channels are wired to agent groups. Claude can inspect current state, create new wirings, rewire channels, and guide you through CLI setup steps.
howto.when_en: After adding a new channel, during initial setup, or when you need to reconfigure existing channel-to-agent-group mappings.

say_en.text: Connect my Discord channel to the support agent group.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the wiring process.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are configured but not wired.
say_en.note: Claude displays a list of configured channels without DB entities.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group and wire it to an existing agent.
say_en.note: Claude asks for isolation level and runs the register step.
